# Aide — Offline-First Business Management Platform

> Aide is an offline-first POS, inventory and reporting app for Kenyan businesses — salons, shops, restaurants, pharmacies. Sell on the POS, track stock, print receipts, export sales. Works without internet and syncs when online.

**Live:** https://aide.omixsystems.store
**GitHub:** https://github.com/oliver4441/aide
**Company:** Omix Digital Solutions (Kenya)
**Support:** omixsystems@gmail.com · +254 768 213 649
**Live chat:** Tawk.to widget on the site

## What Aide Does

- **Point of Sale** — build a cart, take cash, M-Pesa or card, generate a receipt
- **Inventory** — add products, auto-generate SKUs, group by category, low-stock alerts
- **Sales history** — activity log, filter by date, export as CSV or JSON, print receipts
- **Reports** — revenue charts (last 7 days), top products, payment-method breakdown
- **Receipts** — supermarket-grade, thermal or A4 PDF, QR code the customer can scan
- **Notifications** — in-app notification centre for sales, low stock and system updates
- **Settings** — business profile, categories, currency, tax rate, sync conflicts, data export
- **Offline-first** — data is stored on the device and syncs when online
- **Admin console** — businesses, users, sales, revenue, reviews

## Install

Aide ships in three variants. Current builds, file sizes and SHA-256 checksums: https://aide.omixsystems.store/downloads

- **PWA** — open https://aide.omixsystems.store in a browser and choose "Add to Home Screen"
- **Android APK** — built via GitHub Actions, published on GitHub Releases
- **Windows EXE** — built via GitHub Actions, published on GitHub Releases

## Public Routes

- `/` — Landing page (product overview, variants in KES, FAQ, downloads)
- `/downloads` — Download Aide (PWA, Android APK, Windows EXE, checksums)
- `/help` — Help Centre (getting started, run guide, FAQ, contact)
- `/docs` — Documentation (getting started, concepts, guides, API reference, changelog)
- `/privacy` — Privacy policy
- `/terms` — Terms of service
- `/r/[id]` — Shared receipt viewer (public, per-sale permalink)

Sign-in (`/login`) is a private auth screen and is not indexed.

## Tech Stack

- **Next.js 14** (App Router, TypeScript)
- **Tailwind CSS** with semantic colour tokens
- **Prisma** → **Neon PostgreSQL** (offline-first sync)
- **NextAuth** (credentials provider, email + password)
- **Dexie** (IndexedDB) for offline local storage
- **PWA**: manifest + service worker + installable

## Offline Sync

- Client is source of truth (IndexedDB via Dexie)
- Client generates UUIDs
- Sync to Neon via `POST /api/sync`
- Deterministic conflict resolver (LWW for descriptions, movement-ledger for stock)
- Auto-sync on reconnect, outbox with retry/backoff

## SEO

- Canonical domain: `https://aide.omixsystems.store`
- Per-page unique title, description, canonical, OG image and Twitter card
- robots.txt: allows public pages and `/_next/` assets; disallows `/dashboard`, `/api/` and `/login`
- sitemap.xml: `/`, `/downloads`, `/help`, `/docs` (+ all 24 doc pages), `/privacy`, `/terms`
- Structured data: `Organization` + `WebSite` sitewide, `SoftwareApplication` + `FAQPage` on the landing page
